عَوْزَمٌ A she-camel advanced in age, (As, S, K, TA,) and so عَوْزَمَةٌ as expl. by IAar, (TA,) but having somewhat remaining of youthful vigour; (As, S, K, TA;) as also ↓ عَزُومٌ ; (K, TA;) of which the pl. is عُزُمٌ: (TA:) or one whose teeth have been eroded by old age: or one extremely aged, such as is termed دِلْقِمٌ: [but see دَلُوقٌ:] the pl. is عَوَازِمُ. (TA.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) An old woman; (S, K;) as also ↓ عَزُومٌ . (K.) ―
-b3- And Short, as an epithet applied to a woman. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
